overall: Tomorrow in Atlanta looks to be a warm early-June day with the ensemble model pointing to a high around 84°F, though meaningful uncertainty exists across the model suite. The very flat probability distribution — with the top bucket reaching only 4% — signals a broadly spread forecast rather than a confident consensus. Conditions are likely typical early-summer with potential for convective variability influencing the afternoon peak.

max_temp_prediction: The ensemble mean TMAX of 84.0°F is the most defensible anchor given the extremely flat probability distribution — no single bucket exceeds 4%, indicating the forecast energy is spread across a wide temperature range. Confidence is low; the actual high could reasonably fall anywhere from the low 80s to low 90s depending on cloud cover and convective timing.
